protocol.split: per opponent: replicates 0..19 train, 20..23 validation, 24..31 test
protocol.histories: same frozen opponent at seats 1/3, u195450 at 0/2, 10 consecutive rounds; normal match restart if terminal; all public events retained
protocol.posterior: whole-round public likelihood; exact when opponent starting hands are determined by public completed-round cards; otherwise coherent residual-hand importance integration
protocol.public_only: played cards, remaining counts, public tribute ledger and board state; original private deals and RNG seeds excluded from likelihood and probes
protocol.duplicate_cards: proposal corrected by prod residual_count! / prod pre-tribute initial_count!
protocol.primary_metric: independent-question Brier improvement and fraction of true-identity benefit recovered; 11 types primary, full actions secondary
protocol.question_bank: .work/filtered-identity-oracle-2026-11-15; fixed independent neutral-prefix questions; no new question selection
protocol.controls: no history, different-opponent history, same-identity independent history, true identity; known planted preference controls in tests; exact cases and independent particle halves
protocol.probes: raw public token sequence; embedding, encoder layers 1..4, final norm; frozen native attention output; train-only scaling and heldout validation; no main model optimization
protocol.scope: isolated CPU <=4 workers, frozen checkpoints and main training untouched

likelihood_audit.limitation: Finite Monte Carlo reference is not certified Bayes-optimal; exact-round-only is a public feature reference, not full posterior.

precision_extension.selection: first two test replicates 24/25 per identity, chosen before their high-precision outcomes

protocol.reason: generic raw-token and all frozen-layer probes fail to generalize; test whether explicit public choice opportunities make identity learnable
protocol.scope: post-hoc diagnostic design, prospective fresh test replicates 32..39; original train 0..19 and validation 20..23; no reuse of test 24..31 for choosing this head
protocol.eligibility: only completed rounds where both opponent hands are uniquely reconstructed from public events; omit ambiguous rounds for all compared feature arms
protocol.features: choice-only 11-type counts; opportunity-conditioned 6x11 residual counts; u195450 final-action-layer score feature h(chosen)-sum_a pi(a)h(a)
protocol.reference: only frozen u195450 policy; no candidate pool weights used to construct input features
protocol.private_boundary: replay uses public.pt and public-constrained residual sampler; audit-private.pt is never read
protocol.model: weighted ridge to 20 identity indicators, prior residual, train-only standardization; alpha selected by validation identity Brier including prior-only option
protocol.control: same resolved-round availability/count/length in all arms; predictions scored on same independent question bank; fresh histories whole-sequence split

fit_audit.scope: three repeated independent heads, train/validation only; no test selection or replacement of original results

audit.scope: local frozen gameplay and independent diagnostic heads only

reproducibility.note: Collection protocol is retained unchanged; likelihood-only sampler improvements and later analysis audits have separate stage receipts. Some per-task source hashes were read at task completion while a guard-only sampler patch was in flight; source identity is stage-level, not a claim of immutable process-image attestation.
